_comment: Check families the pinned clang-tidy config does not enable, but which this project still enforces.
上游钉住的 .clang-tidy 没有启用、但本项目仍然强制的检查族。
**Why a second list instead of editing the config.** `.github/misc/.clang-tidy` is byte-pinned by the `scaffold` gate:
touching it means the next upstream release cannot be merged without replaying private code by hand. But clang-tidy
takes `--checks` on the command line, and that flag overrides the config's `Checks` key while the config's
`CheckOptions` and `HeaderFilterRegex` still apply. So the pinned file stays byte-identical, and the extra families
are enforced by this repository's own gate.
**为什么另开一张表而不去改配置。** `.github/misc/.clang-tidy` 被 `scaffold` 门字节钉住：动它意味着下一次上游发版
必须手抄私有代码才能合并。但 clang-tidy 支持命令行 `--checks`，它会覆盖配置里的 `Checks` 键，而配置里的
`CheckOptions` 与 `HeaderFilterRegex` 依然生效。于是钉住的文件字节不变，多出来的检查族由本仓库自己的门禁强制执行。
**A family enters this list only after it measures clean or is covered by a permit.** `cert-*` was measured at 82 headers
and 42 sources: three sites, all `cert-dcl59-cpp`, all fixed (an unnamed namespace in a header gives every translation
unit its own internal-linkage copy). A family that is enabled while still red would turn every build red, which is a
way of switching a gate off, not on.
**只有先量干净、或被偏差许可覆盖的族才能进这张表。** `cert-*` 在 82 个头与 42 个源文件上量到三处命中，全是
`cert-dcl59-cpp`，且已全部修掉（头文件里的无名命名空间会让每个 TU 各得一份内部链接副本）。一个还带红就启用的族
会把每次构建都弄红——那是把门禁关掉的一种方式，不是打开。

why.en: The CERT C++ secure-coding rules. Measured at zero on both trees before being switched on, and the three sites it found on the way are fixed rather than suppressed.
why.zh: CERT C++ 安全编码规则。启用前在两棵树上都量到 0；沿途发现的 3 处已修掉而不是抑制掉。

why.en: The pinned config names `bugprone-*` but resolves to nothing -- see the note below on why that is the template's stance rather than a defect. This gate is where **this project** declares extra strictness, supplied from outside the pinned file (`scaffold` pins it, so it is not ours to edit) and run over all 125 targets. It found 46 unique diagnostics: 12 signed-bitwise, 2 incorrect-roundings, 1 branch-clone and 31 easily-swappable-parameters. The first three classes are fixed; the last is exempted with a record, because its advice is to restructure every signature that takes two adjacent floats -- `step(dt, angle)`, `park(alpha, beta)`, `reconstruct(a, b)` -- which is the shape of this library's API, not a defect in it. The pinned config is a **loose baseline of intent, by design**: its `Checks:` is a folded scalar and the `#` lines inside it are literal, so `clang-tidy --dump-config` resolves the list to `-*` and the `tidy` gate constrains nothing. That is the template's posture, not a defect to report upstream: private-domain syntax -- `// Conan::ImportStart` and the rest -- is governed by the IaC layer (`.github/skills/_shared/code-conventions.md`, `.github/misc/Codegen-Starter.txt`, the `het-*` skills), so the linter is deliberately kept out of that argument and stays compatible with whatever an instance decides. Decided by zc on 2026-11-06: do not send this upstream.
why.zh: 钉住的配置点名了 `bugprone-*` 却解析成空集——为什么那是模板的姿态而不是缺陷，见下面的说明。本门是**本项目**声明额外严格度的地方：在钉住文件之外供给（它被 `scaffold` 锁定，不归我们改），扫全部 125 个目标。实测 46 条去重诊断：12 条 signed-bitwise、2 条 incorrect-roundings、1 条 branch-clone、31 条 easily-swappable-parameters。前三类已修；最后一类带偏差单豁免，因为它要求把所有接受两个相邻 `float` 的函数签名重构（`step(dt, angle)`、`park(alpha, beta)`、`reconstruct(a, b)`），那是本库 API 的形状。 钉住的配置是**刻意松的口径**：`Checks:` 是折叠标量、里面的 `#` 是字面量，于是 `clang-tidy --dump-config` 解析出的集合是 `-*`，`tidy` 门什么都不约束。这是模板的姿态，不是要报给上游的缺陷——私域语法（`// Conan::ImportStart` 之类）由 IaC 层管控（`.github/skills/_shared/code-conventions.md`、`.github/misc/Codegen-Starter.txt`、`het-*` 技能），所以 linter 被刻意排除在这个论证之外，以便与任何实例的取舍保持兼容。zc 于 2026-11-06 拍板：不报上游。

why.en: The path-sensitive analyzer: null dereference, dead store, uninitialized read, division by zero. It is the only family in this table whose findings are defects rather than style, and it measured **0 on all 125 targets** (clang-tidy 23.1.3) before being switched on, so enabling it costs one run and no edits. That is the whole argument: a check that reports nothing today is not noise, it is a net -- the next out-of-bounds read is invisible to every other gate in this repository. `--selftest` holds the positive control: a null dereference in a scratch file must be diagnosed with the family on and clean with it off, so a silent analyzer cannot pass as a clean one.
why.zh: 路径敏感分析器：空指针解引用、死存储、未初始化读、除零。这是本表里**唯一报的是缺陷而不是风格**的族，且启用前在全部 125 个目标上量到 **0 条**（clang-tidy 23.1.3）——所以启用它只花一次运行、零处修改。理由就是这一点：今天报 0 的检查不是噪声，是网——下一次越界读在本仓库其它任何门里都看不见。正控制在 `--selftest` 里：一个临时文件里的空指针解引用，族开着必须报、关掉必须干净；这样「分析器没跑」就不能伪装成「分析器很干净」。

why.en: Measured **0 on 125 targets** before being switched on. For a control loop that runs inside an interrupt, an accidental copy or a `std::string` taken by value is the kind of regression no passing test reports -- and today there is nothing to fix, so the family is free. It is enabled for the day someone adds a parameter that copies. Note on provenance: the pinned config's `Checks:` folded scalar *names* `performance-*`, so the composed set already carries it; listing it here is what makes this gate **report** it, and what records the zero. Without the entry the family would be silently enforced and silently ignored.
why.zh: 启用前在 125 个目标上量到 **0 条**。对一个跑在中断里的控制环来说，多出来的一次拷贝、按值收的 `std::string`，正是「测试全绿也看不出」的那类退化——而今天没有一处要修，所以这一族是白得的。启用它是为了某天有人加了一个会拷贝的参数。 出处说明：钉住配置里 `Checks:` 那段折叠标量**点名了** `performance-*`，所以组合后的检查串本来就带着它；列进这张表才让本门真的**报**它，也才留下这个 0。不写这一条，这一族会被默默执行、默默忽略。

why.en: Three of the five members that fire are kept, because each can indicate a real defect in a header-only library: `misc-definitions-in-headers` (1 -- a non-inline definition in a header gives every including translation unit its own copy, which is the ODR violation `cert-dcl59-cpp` found three of earlier), `misc-use-internal-linkage` (24, one file -- a function nothing outside its unit calls that is not `static`), `misc-const-correctness` (19, three files). The other two are removed rather than kept: `misc-include-cleaner` is taken out of the family by the `-misc-include-cleaner` term, because it reports 290 times over 117 files that a header "is not used directly", and this is a library whose headers exist to be included by each other and to re-expose types on purpose -- include-what-you-use is the wrong model for a public API surface. `misc-non-private-member-variables-in-classes` (47, five files) is exempted with `deviation/misc-non-private-member-variables-in-classes.md`: every one of those members belongs to a configuration aggregate passed by `const&`, never derived from, with no virtual functions, and the rule's advice -- "make it a class" -- is precisely what these value types are not.
why.zh: 报出来的 5 个成员里留 3 个，因为每个在 header-only 库里都可能指向真缺陷：`misc-definitions-in-headers`（1 条——头文件里的非 inline 定义会让每个包含它的 TU 各得一份，就是先前 `cert-dcl59-cpp` 抓到的那类 ODR 违反）、`misc-use-internal-linkage`（24 条，1 个文件——本单元之外无人调用却没有 `static`）、`misc-const-correctness`（19 条，3 个文件）。另两个是剔除而不是保留：`misc-include-cleaner` 由 `-misc-include-cleaner` 这一项移出族外，因为它在 117 个文件上报了 290 次「头文件没有被直接使用」，而本库的头文件本来就是互相包含、并刻意把类型重新暴露出去的——include-what-you-use 对公开 API 面是错的模型。`misc-non-private-member-variables-in-classes`（47 条，5 个文件）带 `deviation/misc-non-private-member-variables-in-classes.md` 豁免：这些成员全部属于按 `const&` 传、不被继承、无虚函数的配置聚合体，而规则的建议「做成类」恰恰是这些值类型**不是**的东西。

why.en: The one member of the family that fires on something a reader cannot see: `readability-inconsistent-declaration-parameter-name` (1) reports the same parameter named differently in the header and in the definition -- `MotionProfile::shape(float target_rad, ...)` declared, `shape(float setpoint, ...)` defined -- which is how a caller's editor hint and the `@param` line start describing two different things. `readability-simplify-boolean-expr` was in this entry for one run and was taken out again: all 9 of its findings are DeMorgan rewrites of validation guards (`if (!(std::isfinite(x) && (x > 0.0F)))`), and `if (!a || !b)` is the harder of the two to check against the sentence above it. It is in `relaxed` now, with that measurement.
why.zh: 这一族里只有一条报的是读者看不见的东西：`readability-inconsistent-declaration-parameter-name`（1 条）指出同一个参数在头文件与定义里叫不同名字——声明是 `MotionProfile::shape(float target_rad, ...)`、定义是 `shape(float setpoint, ...)`——调用方的编辑器提示与 `@param` 那一行从此描述的是两件不同的事。`readability-simplify-boolean-expr` 在这条记录里待过一轮就被拿掉了：它那 9 条全是把校验守卫改写成德摩根形式（`if (!(std::isfinite(x) && (x > 0.0F)))`），而 `if (!a || !b)` 更难和它上面那句判据对上。它现在在 `relaxed` 里，带着那个测量。

why.en: The two measurements that disagreed by 670 have been reconciled, and the answer is that the pinned config constrains nothing -- see the note on why that is a stance, not a defect. The family sweep over today's 125 targets reports **1048 diagnostics in 14 checks** (`-*,cppcoreguidelines-*`, clang-tidy 23.1.3), of which 579 are `avoid-magic-numbers`, 121 `pro-bounds-constant-array-index`, 76 `use-default-member-init`, 75 `avoid-c-arrays`, 57 `pro-bounds-pointer-arithmetic`, 53 `pro-type-member-init`, 39 `special-member-functions`; with the comment lines removed the same 42 sources report 383, of which 73 are `bugprone-*` and 310 are `cppcoreguidelines-avoid-magic-numbers`. An earlier record said 1365 in 15 checks, measured before `.h` stopped being handed to the C++ view: those 317 extra were C++ rules run on C headers, which is the reading this repository has since decided against. So the count is no longer the blocker: the question is whether **this project** wants the family. It does not adopt it wholesale, because most of what it reports is C-ABI and API shape. The pinned config is a **loose baseline of intent, by design**: its `Checks:` is a folded scalar and the `#` lines inside it are literal, so `clang-tidy --dump-config` resolves the list to `-*` and the `tidy` gate constrains nothing. That is the template's posture, not a defect to report upstream: private-domain syntax -- `// Conan::ImportStart` and the rest -- is governed by the IaC layer (`.github/skills/_shared/code-conventions.md`, `.github/misc/Codegen-Starter.txt`, the `het-*` skills), so the linter is deliberately kept out of that argument and stays compatible with whatever an instance decides. Decided by zc on 2026-11-06: do not send this upstream.
why.zh: 差 670 的两个测量对上了，答案是钉住的配置什么都不约束——为什么那是姿态而不是缺陷，见下面的说明。按今天的目标集（125 个）整族扫得 **1048 条 / 14 个检查**（`-*,cppcoreguidelines-*`，clang-tidy 23.1.3），其中 `avoid-magic-numbers` 579、`pro-bounds-constant-array-index` 121、`use-default-member-init` 76、`avoid-c-arrays` 75、`pro-bounds-pointer-arithmetic` 57、`pro-type-member-init` 53、`special-member-functions` 39；把注释行去掉后同样 42 个源文件 383 条，其中 `bugprone-*` 73 条、`cppcoreguidelines-avoid-magic-numbers` 310 条。早先记录写的是 1365 条 / 15 个检查，那是在「`.h` 还交给 C++ 视图」时量的：多出的 317 条是拿 C++ 规则去看 C 头，正是本仓库后来决定不再采用的口径。所以计数不再是阻塞点：问题变成**本项目**要不要这一族。答案是不整族收——它报的多数是 C ABI 与 API 形状。 钉住的配置是**刻意松的口径**：`Checks:` 是折叠标量、里面的 `#` 是字面量，于是 `clang-tidy --dump-config` 解析出的集合是 `-*`，`tidy` 门什么都不约束。这是模板的姿态，不是要报给上游的缺陷——私域语法（`// Conan::ImportStart` 之类）由 IaC 层管控（`.github/skills/_shared/code-conventions.md`、`.github/misc/Codegen-Starter.txt`、`het-*` 技能），所以 linter 被刻意排除在这个论证之外，以便与任何实例的取舍保持兼容。zc 于 2026-11-06 拍板：不报上游。

relaxed.evidence: 807 diagnostics / 9 checks over 125 targets (clang-tidy 23.1.3, `-*,modernize-*`): concat-nested-namespaces 327 (78 files), use-trailing-return-type 145, use-using 84, use-default-member-init 76, avoid-c-arrays 75, use-auto 66, use-nodiscard 26, loop-convert 6, redundant-void-arg 2. The members that would catch a defect -- use-nullptr, make-unique, use-override, use-emplace -- report 0.

why.en: Nothing in this family that fires can indicate a defect; the members that could report zero. The two with an argument are `use-auto` and `use-default-member-init`, and both arguments point the other way here: a quantity's type is part of this interface's meaning (`float` vs `std::int32_t` vs `std::uint32_t` is a fixed-width ABI decision, not a local convenience, so `auto` erases the thing being documented), and the member initialisers are spelled in the constructor because the aggregate is documented that way and `constexpr` construction is part of the contract. `avoid-c-arrays` is the C ABI's shape (`foc_api.h` takes `float[3]` because C callers pass arrays).
why.zh: 这一族报出来的成员里没有一条能指向缺陷；能指向缺陷的那几个都是 0。需要论证的只有两个，而且论证都指向反面：量值的类型是这个接口含义的一部分（`float` / `std::int32_t` / `std::uint32_t` 是定宽 ABI 的决定，不是局部便利，`auto` 恰好抹掉了要被记录下来的那个东西），成员初始化写在构造函数里是因为聚合体本身就是那样记录的、`constexpr` 构造在契约之内。`avoid-c-arrays` 是 C ABI 的形状（`foc_api.h` 收 `float[3]`，因为 C 调用方传数组）。

relaxed.evidence: 1611 diagnostics / 15 checks over 125 targets (clang-tidy 23.1.3, `-*,readability-*`): magic-numbers 579 (98 files), identifier-length 429 (39), math-missing-parentheses 210 (16), trailing-comma 138 (31), redundant-casting 103 (20), convert-member-functions-to-static 69 (20), redundant-member-init 19 (4), nested-conditional-operator 18 (14), named-parameter 10, function-cognitive-complexity 10, simplify-boolean-expr 9 (3 files, all DeMorgan), use-std-min-max 8, concise-preprocessor-directives 5, make-member-function-const 3 -- plus inconsistent-declaration-parameter-name 1, which is the one check this project **does** run (see the `readability` family).

why.en: `readability-*` is 15 checks and the entry names the two that stay on, so this record is about the other thirteen. Three of them would be worth a reader's attention and none of them can indicate a defect. `identifier-length` (429) asks for 3+ characters; this library's names are `i`, `u`, `v`, `w`, `dt`, `kp`, `ki`, `id`, `iq`, `th` -- the symbols of the physical model, and renaming them moves the code away from the paper each law is derived from. `magic-numbers` (579) is the same signal as `cppcoreguidelines-avoid-magic-numbers`; every one of those numbers **is** the documentation (a resistance, a flux, a threshold from a datasheet), and naming each one `kFoo` separates the code from the source it is transcribed from. `math-missing-parentheses` (210) reports where precedence is *subtle*, not where it is *wrong*: the compiler's own `-Wparentheses`, already on, covers the shapes that are actually ambiguous (assignment in a condition, `&&` mixed with `||`), and what this check flags here is `a * b + c * d`. The remaining ten are spelling (`trailing-comma`, `named-parameter`, `nested-conditional-operator`, `concise-preprocessor-directives`, `use-std-min-max`) or preference (`redundant-casting` in a float-typed library, `convert-member-functions-to-static`, `redundant-member-init`, `make-member-function-const`). `simplify-boolean-expr` (9) is the fourth that gets looked at twice, and it loses on its own evidence: every one of those 9 is a DeMorgan rewrite of a validation guard (`if (!(std::isfinite(x) && (x > 0.0F)))`), and the rewritten `if (!a || !b)` is worse to read against the sentence that justifies the guard, so the check finds nothing here that is not already spelled the clearest way. `function-cognitive-complexity` is a cost, not a defect: the four functions it flags are the documented control laws, and splitting them to satisfy a threshold would separate a formula from its derivation -- which is the one thing this library's docs are built around.
why.zh: `readability-*` 是 15 条检查，本记录说的是留在族里那 2 条之外的 13 条。其中 3 条值得看一眼，但都没有一条能指向缺陷。`identifier-length`（429 条）要求名字 3 个字符以上；而本库的名字是 `i`、`u`、`v`、`w`、`dt`、`kp`、`ki`、`id`、`iq`、`th`——物理模型的记号，改名等于把代码改离每条定律的出处。`magic-numbers`（579 条）与 `cppcoreguidelines-avoid-magic-numbers` 是同一个信号；那些数**本身**就是文档（一个电阻、一个磁链、数据手册上的一个阈值），逐个起名 `kFoo` 反而把代码与它转录的来源分开。`math-missing-parentheses`（210 条）报的是优先级**微妙**的地方，不是**错**的地方：真正有歧义的形状（条件里赋值、`&&` 与 `||` 混用）由已经打开的 `-Wparentheses` 覆盖，而这条检查在这里报的是 `a * b + c * d`。剩下 10 条是拼写（`trailing-comma`、`named-parameter`、`nested-conditional-operator`、`concise-preprocessor-directives`、`use-std-min-max`）或偏好（float 类型库里的 `redundant-casting`、`convert-member-functions-to-static`、`redundant-member-init`、`make-member-function-const`）。`simplify-boolean-expr`（9 条）是第 4 条值得多看一眼的，而它被自己的证据否掉了：那 9 条全是校验守卫的德摩根改写（`if (!(std::isfinite(x) && (x > 0.0F)))`），改写后的 `if (!a || !b)` 跟上面那句判据对着读更费劲，所以这条检查在这里没指出任何「没写清楚的写法」。`function-cognitive-complexity` 是成本而不是缺陷：它报的那 4 个函数就是文档化的控制律，为了过阈值把它们拆开，等于把公式与推导分开——而那恰好是本库文档赖以成立的那件事。

relaxed.evidence: 290 diagnostics over 117 of 125 targets (clang-tidy 23.1.3, `-*,misc-*`), all of the form "included header X is not used directly".

why.en: Include-what-you-use is the right model for an application and the wrong one for a public API surface: this library's headers include each other to re-expose types (`foc/core/types.hpp` pulls in the scalar aliases, the aggregate headers pull in `types.hpp` so a caller can name what it passes), and `foc_api.h` includes `foc_types.h` so a C caller gets one include. Every one of the 290 findings is that pattern. Satisfying it would mean either duplicating the type aliases per header or deleting the re-exports the API is built on.
why.zh: include-what-you-use 对应用是对的模型，对公开 API 面是错的：本库的头文件互相包含是为了把类型重新暴露出去（`foc/core/types.hpp` 带出标量别名，各聚合头带出 `types.hpp` 好让调用方能写出它传的是什么），`foc_api.h` 包含 `foc_types.h` 是为了让 C 调用方只写一个 include。290 条全部是这一种模式。要满足它，只能么把类型别名在每个头里复制一遍，要么删掉 API 赖以成立的再导出。
